blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解藥品短缺作為全球性問題的成因多樣性，包括製造、商業、經濟地理與可靠性等四大類因素。
blocks.en: Understand the diverse causes of drug shortage as a global problem, including the four categories of factors: manufacturing, business, economic/geographic and reliability.

blocks.zh: 區分 FDA、EMA、WHO 對「藥品短缺」（drug shortage）的不同定義，並了解其對 CDMO 合規義務的影響。
blocks.en: Distinguish the different definitions of "drug shortage" used by FDA, EMA and WHO, and understand their impact on a CDMO's compliance obligations.

blocks.zh: 掌握美國 Section 506C、歐盟 GMP 指令 2017/1572 Article 13 等主要法規的通報要求與時限。
blocks.en: Master the notification requirements and timelines of the main regulations, such as US Section 506C and Article 13 of EU GMP Directive 2017/1572.

blocks.zh: 了解 TR-68 以製造與品質問題為核心的風險導向管理框架，以及其在供應鏈各層級的應用方式。
blocks.en: Understand the TR-68 risk-oriented management framework centered on manufacturing and quality problems, and how it is applied at each level of the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 明確資深管理階層（Senior Management）在 MAH 合規義務、品質文化建立及短缺預防中的問責角色。
blocks.en: Be clear about the accountable role of senior management in MAH compliance obligations, in building a quality culture and in shortage prevention.

blocks.zh: 將藥品短缺認識為全球性問題  |  p6–p8
blocks.en: Drug Shortage as a Global Problem  |  p6–p8

blocks.zh: 中文解析與應用指引
blocks.en: Commentary and Application Guide

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何藥品短缺是全球問題？
blocks.en: Core concept: why is drug shortage a global problem?

blocks.zh: TR-68 的第一個重要聲明——藥品短缺管理的首要目標是防止病患受害（preventing harm to patients）——確立了本文件的核心倫理立場：供應連續性不僅是商業考量，更是病患安全義務。
blocks.en: The first important statement of TR-68, that the primary goal of drug shortage management is preventing harm to patients, establishes the ethical stance of the document: continuity of supply is not merely a commercial consideration but an obligation for patient safety.

blocks.zh: 本節以製造與品質問題為主軸，區別於商業或經濟因素，為後續各節的風險評估框架奠定範疇。
blocks.en: This section centers on manufacturing and quality problems, as distinct from commercial or economic factors, and sets the scope for the risk assessment framework in the following sections.

blocks.zh: 案例解析：乙腈大短缺（2008–2009）
blocks.en: Case study: the acetonitrile shortage (2008-2009)

blocks.zh: 乙腈（Acetonitrile）是 HPLC（高效液相層析法）最常用的有機溶劑，廣泛用於藥品分析方法中。2008 年的「乙腈大短缺」完美示範了供應鏈單點依賴（single-point dependency）的脆弱性：
blocks.en: Acetonitrile is the organic solvent most commonly used in HPLC (high-performance liquid chromatography) and is widely used in pharmaceutical analytical methods. The 2008 "acetonitrile shortage" is a perfect illustration of the fragility of single-point dependency in the supply chain:

blocks.zh: 事件一：中國奧運前停產 → 生產端衝擊
blocks.en: Event 1: production shut down in China ahead of the Olympics, a manufacturing-side shock

blocks.zh: 事件二：德州颶風打斷生產 → 地理集中風險
blocks.en: Event 2: a hurricane in Texas interrupted production, a geographic concentration risk

blocks.zh: 合力結果：多個 API 和藥品出現全球性短缺
blocks.en: Combined result: global shortages of multiple APIs and drug products

blocks.zh: 把這個故事想像成「城市只有兩家麵包廠，都在同一個低窪地帶——一旦淹水，全城人無麵包可吃」。對 CDMO 而言，這意味著關鍵輔料（溶劑、賦形劑）的供應商多元化是風險管理的必要措施，而非可選項。
blocks.en: Imagine "a city with only two bakeries, both located in the same low-lying area: once it floods, the whole city has no bread". For a CDMO, this means that supplier diversification for critical ancillary materials (solvents, excipients) is a necessary risk management measure, not an optional one.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Figure 3.0-1 的四大類因素對 CDMO 的啟示
blocks.en: Key point: what the four categories of factors in Figure 3.0-1 mean for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 理解 Figure 3.0-1 的關鍵不在列清單，而在認識整個生態系統的相互依存：
blocks.en: The key to understanding Figure 3.0-1 is not to list the items but to recognize the interdependence of the whole ecosystem:

blocks.zh: 製造類（Manufacturing）：CDMO 直接控制——製程變異、設備、產能均屬核心管理範疇
blocks.en: Manufacturing: directly controlled by the CDMO; process variability, equipment and capacity are all core management topics

blocks.zh: 商業類（Business）：MAH 主導，但 CDMO 需配合提供產能承諾與備料計畫
blocks.en: Business: led by the MAH, but the CDMO needs to cooperate by providing capacity commitments and material stocking plans

blocks.zh: 經濟/地理類：多為外部因素，但定價壓縮影響備料投資意願
blocks.en: Economic/geographic: mostly external factors, but price compression affects willingness to invest in stock

blocks.zh: 可靠性類（Reliability）：包含天災、疫情——正是 COVID-19 暴露的盲點
blocks.en: Reliability: includes natural disasters and pandemics, precisely the blind spot that COVID-19 exposed

blocks.zh: 媒體角色（media role）也被明確列為因素：一旦短缺消息外流，恐慌性囤積（stockpiling）可能加劇原本可控的供應不足，形成惡性循環。
blocks.en: The role of the media is also explicitly listed as a factor: once news of a shortage leaks out, panic stockpiling can aggravate a supply gap that was otherwise manageable, creating a vicious cycle.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 | Comprehension Check
blocks.en: Discussion questions | Comprehension Check

blocks.zh: Q1：乙腈短缺中，FDA 允許廠商將分析方法變更列為「minor change in Annual Report」。這與 CDMO 的日常作業有何關聯？（提示：21 CFR 314.70(d)(2)(vii)）
blocks.en: Q1: In the acetonitrile shortage, FDA allowed manufacturers to report an analytical method change as a "minor change in the Annual Report". How is this relevant to a CDMO's day-to-day operations? (Hint: 21 CFR 314.70(d)(2)(vii))

blocks.zh: Q2：Figure 3.0-1 中，哪一類因素是 CDMO 最有能力主動管控的？哪一類最難預測？
blocks.en: Q2: In Figure 3.0-1, which category of factors is the one a CDMO is best able to control proactively? Which is the hardest to predict?

blocks.zh: Q3：Rx-360 這類供應鏈聯盟的存在，說明了什麼類型的治理機制在全球藥品短缺管理中是必要的？
blocks.en: Q3: What does the existence of supply chain consortia such as Rx-360 say about the type of governance mechanism needed in global drug shortage management?

blocks.zh: 術語定義的演進  |  p8
blocks.en: Evolution of Terminology  |  p8

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：定義差異如同「塞車」的判斷標準
blocks.en: Analogy: definition differences are like the criteria for "traffic jam"

blocks.zh: 想像不同城市對「塞車」有不同定義：紐約認為速度低於 20 km/h 才算塞車，巴黎認為停等超過 10 分鐘才算，而 WHO 認為只要乘客無法準時到達目的地就算。
blocks.en: Imagine different cities define a "traffic jam" differently: New York says it is a jam only when speed falls below 20 km/h, Paris says only when vehicles are stopped for more than 10 minutes, and the WHO says it is a jam whenever passengers cannot reach their destination on time.

blocks.zh: 對於跨國 CDMO 而言，同一條供應鏈中斷事件，在美國可能觸發 FDA Section 506C 通報義務，在歐盟則觸發 Article 13 通報要求，在各成員國又有各自的本地法規。必須同時了解所有相關轄區的定義與通報門檻。
blocks.en: For a multinational CDMO, the same supply chain disruption may trigger an FDA Section 506C notification obligation in the US and an Article 13 notification requirement in the EU, with further local regulations in each Member State. You must understand the definitions and notification thresholds of all relevant jurisdictions at the same time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「Meaningful Disruption」與 CDMO 的關係
blocks.en: Key point: "Meaningful Disruption" and the CDMO

blocks.zh: 「meaningful disruption（重大中斷）」這個術語在美國法規中有特定含義——FDA FDASIA Section 1001 要求製造商在預期的「meaningful disruption in supply」發生前六個月通報。
blocks.en: The term "meaningful disruption" has a specific meaning in US regulation: Section 1001 of FDASIA requires manufacturers to notify FDA six months before an anticipated "meaningful disruption in supply".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means:

blocks.zh: 若預期設備停機、批次失敗率上升或原料短缺，需主動評估是否觸發通報義務
blocks.en: If equipment downtime, a rising batch failure rate or a raw material shortage is anticipated, proactively assess whether a notification obligation is triggered

blocks.zh: 合約中應明定 CDMO 向 MAH 通報的內部觸發條件與時限
blocks.en: The contract should define the internal trigger conditions and timelines for the CDMO's notification to the MAH

blocks.zh: 「沒有通報義務」≠「不需要告知 MAH」——資訊透明是防止短缺惡化的前提
blocks.en: "No notification obligation" does not equal "no need to inform the MAH"; transparency of information is a precondition for preventing a shortage from getting worse

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語速查
blocks.en: Quick reference to key terms

blocks.zh:
Drug Shortage（藥品短缺）
  = 需求 > 供給的時間段（FDA 定義）

Stockout（斷貨）
  = 短缺未及時解決，導致病患服務點無藥可用（WHO）

Medically Necessary Product（醫療必要產品）
  = 無替代品或替代品不足以滿足需求的藥品

Critical Medicine（關鍵藥品，EU）
  = 滿足以下條件：
    (1) 具治療用途
    (2) 無可替代藥品
    (3) 供應鏈具有脆弱性
blocks.en:
Drug Shortage
  = a period of time when demand exceeds supply (FDA definition)

Stockout
  = a shortage not resolved in time, so that no drug is available at the patient service point (WHO)

Medically Necessary Product
  = a drug with no alternative, or whose alternatives are insufficient to meet demand

Critical Medicine (EU)
  = meets the following conditions:
    (1) has a therapeutic use
    (2) has no substitute drug
    (3) has a vulnerable supply chain

blocks.zh: Q1：若一個 API 在中國的工廠因環保稽查停產兩個月，依照 FDA、EMA 及 WHO 的定義，各在何種情況下構成「藥品短缺」？
blocks.en: Q1: If a factory producing an API in China is shut down for two months because of an environmental inspection, under what circumstances does this constitute a "drug shortage" under the FDA, EMA and WHO definitions, respectively?

blocks.zh: Q2：EU「關鍵藥品」（critical medicine）標準比 FDA「medically necessary product」多了哪一個評估維度？此差異對 MAH 在 EU 的庫存管理策略有何影響？
blocks.en: Q2: What additional assessment dimension does the EU "critical medicine" criterion have compared with the FDA "medically necessary product"? How does this difference affect the MAH's inventory management strategy in the EU?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三大機構定義比較
blocks.en: Core concept: comparison of the three agencies' definitions

blocks.zh: 目前全球沒有統一的「藥品短缺」國際定義——這本身就是一個合規挑戰。以下為三大主要機構的定義核心：
blocks.en: There is currently no unified international definition of "drug shortage", which is itself a compliance challenge. The core of the definitions of the three main agencies is as follows:

blocks.zh: 通報要求與現行法規環境  |  p8–p10
blocks.en: Notification Requirements and the Current Regulatory Environment  |  p8–p10

blocks.zh: 重點提示：EMA 已明確推薦 TR-68 作為參考文件
blocks.en: Key point: EMA has explicitly recommended TR-68 as a reference document

blocks.zh: 2019 年 HMA/EMA 發布的《MAH 在 EEA 市場藥品短缺偵測與通知指引》中，明確建議 MAH 引用 PDA TR-68 作為參考標準。這代表本技術報告已具有準法規地位（quasi-regulatory status），在歐盟稽查中援引 TR-68 的做法與原則是被鼓勵的。
blocks.en: In the 2019 HMA/EMA guidance on detection and notification of shortages of medicinal products for MAHs in the EEA, MAHs are explicitly advised to cite PDA TR-68 as a reference standard. This means the technical report has quasi-regulatory status, and citing the practices and principles of TR-68 in EU inspections is encouraged.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：通報要求如同「火災警報系統」
blocks.en: Analogy: notification requirements are like a "fire alarm system"

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺的通報義務，就像建築物的火災警報系統規範——每棟建築都必須裝，但美國的 NFPA 規範、歐盟的 EN 規範、台灣的 CNS 規範各有不同標準。
blocks.en: The notification obligations for drug shortages are like fire alarm system codes for buildings: every building must have one, but the US NFPA codes, EU EN standards and Taiwan CNS standards each set different requirements.

blocks.zh: 對跨國 CDMO 而言，「裝了系統但不符合當地規範」與「沒裝」同樣危險。實務上，CDMO 應在合約中明定：
blocks.en: For a multinational CDMO, "having a system that does not meet local codes" is as dangerous as "having no system". In practice, the CDMO should specify in the contract:

blocks.zh: 哪些事件觸發向 MAH 的內部通知（更嚴格於法規門檻）
blocks.en: Which events trigger internal notification to the MAH (stricter than the regulatory thresholds)

blocks.zh: 通知時限（建議 24–72 小時，優於法規要求）
blocks.en: Notification timelines (24-72 hours recommended, better than the regulatory requirements)

blocks.zh: 由 MAH 負責對主管機關的正式通報（CDMO 提供技術支援）
blocks.en: The MAH is responsible for formal notification to the authority (the CDMO provides technical support)

blocks.zh: CDMO 合規檢核清單（Section 3.2）
blocks.en: CDMO Compliance Checklist (Section 3.2)

blocks.zh:
[ ] 已識別所有服務市場的短缺通報法規要求
[ ] 合約中已納入向 MAH 內部通報的觸發條件與時限
[ ] 已建立跨轄區通報差異的 SOP（標準作業程序）
[ ] 已訂閱 FDA 藥品短缺資料庫、EMA shortage platform 的更新
[ ] EFPIA/EGA 協調框架的觸發點（trigger points）已整合
    至公司的 QRM（品質風險管理）系統
[ ] ICH Q9(R1) 對主管機關通知的時效性要求已對應
    至公司的偏差/變更管理程序
blocks.en:
[ ] Shortage notification regulatory requirements of all served markets identified
[ ] Trigger conditions and timelines for internal notification to the MAH included in the contract
[ ] SOP (standard operating procedure) for cross-jurisdiction notification differences established
[ ] Subscribed to updates of the FDA drug shortage database and the EMA shortage platform
[ ] Trigger points of the EFPIA/EGA coordinated framework integrated
    into the company's QRM (quality risk management) system
[ ] ICH Q9(R1) timeliness requirements for notifying authorities mapped
    to the company's deviation/change management procedures

blocks.zh: Q1：依 Section 506C，哪類產品的「需求增加」或「出口限制」不在強制通報範圍內？這對以出口為主的台灣製造商有何實務意涵？
blocks.en: Q1: Under Section 506C, for which type of product are "increased demand" or "export restrictions" outside the mandatory notification scope? What are the practical implications for an export-oriented Taiwanese manufacturer?

blocks.zh: Q2：EU GMP Directive Article 13 要求製造商通知「主管機關和 MAH」，EudraLex Vol.4 Ch.5 Sec.5.71 則要求通知「MAH」。對一個同時擔任製造商和 MAH 的公司，這兩條規定是否有重疊？如何避免雙重通報的混亂？
blocks.en: Q2: EU GMP Directive Article 13 requires manufacturers to notify "the competent authority and the MAH", whereas EudraLex Vol. 4 Chapter 5 Section 5.71 requires notification of "the MAH". For a company that is both manufacturer and MAH, do these two requirements overlap? How can confusion from double notification be avoided?

blocks.zh: Q3：FDA 2013 年《藥品短缺預防策略計畫》強調「正向誘因」（positive incentives）鼓勵廠商改善製造品質。你認為哪些誘因機制最有效？
blocks.en: Q3: The FDA 2013 "Strategic Plan for Preventing and Mitigating Drug Shortages" emphasizes "positive incentives" to encourage manufacturers to improve manufacturing quality. Which incentive mechanisms do you think are most effective?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：主要法規通報要求一覽表
blocks.en: Core concept: summary table of notification requirements in the main regulations

blocks.zh: 以下整理各主要法規轄區的藥品短缺通報義務：
blocks.en: The drug shortage notification obligations in the main regulatory jurisdictions are summarized below:

blocks.zh: 製造與品質問題引起之藥品短缺管理框架  |  p10–p11
blocks.en: Management Framework for Drug Shortages Caused by Manufacturing and Quality Problems  |  p10–p11

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應鏈的「短缺起點」遠比想像的早
blocks.en: Core concept: the "starting point" of a shortage in the supply chain is much earlier than imagined

blocks.zh: TR-68 明確指出，藥品短缺並非從藥房架上缺貨才開始，而是從供應鏈的任一環節的材料無法取得就已開始：
blocks.en: TR-68 points out clearly that a drug shortage does not begin when the pharmacy shelf is empty; it begins as soon as materials cannot be obtained at any point in the supply chain:

blocks.zh: 原料藥（API）或其起始原料（starting material）
blocks.en: Active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) or its starting material

blocks.zh: 賦形劑（excipient）、試劑（reagent）、溶劑（solvent）
blocks.en: Excipients, reagents, solvents

blocks.zh: 包裝材料（packaging material）
blocks.en: Packaging materials

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的意涵是：風險管理必須從原料採購端就開始，而非等到製造失敗才應對。
blocks.en: The implication for a CDMO is that risk management must start at raw material procurement, rather than responding only after manufacturing has failed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：供應鏈如同多米諾骨牌
blocks.en: Analogy: the supply chain as a row of dominoes

blocks.zh: 想像一張骨牌長鏈：API 供應商 → 原料測試 → 製造 → 包裝 → 倉儲 → 配送 → 醫院。任何一張骨牌倒下，後面的都跟著倒——差別在於骨牌之間的「緩衝距離」（亦即庫存與冗餘設計）決定了衝擊能否被吸收。
blocks.en: Imagine a long chain of dominoes: API supplier → raw material testing → manufacturing → packaging → warehousing → distribution → hospital. When any one domino falls, all those behind it fall too; the difference is that the "buffer distance" between the dominoes (that is, inventory and redundancy design) determines whether the impact can be absorbed.

blocks.zh: 「Country-specific import testing requirements（各國特定進口檢測要求）」是一塊特別難預測的骨牌：本可快速恢復的供應中斷，卻因各國進口重新檢測程序，拖延數週而演變成真正的短缺。
blocks.en: "Country-specific import testing requirements" are an especially unpredictable domino: a supply interruption that could have recovered quickly turns into a real shortage because each country's import retesting procedure delays release by weeks.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：TR-68 在 PDA-ISPE-EMA 協作框架中的定位
blocks.en: Key point: the position of TR-68 in the PDA-ISPE-EMA collaboration framework

blocks.zh: TR-68 的制訂是 PDA 與 ISPE 在 EMA 跨協會藥品短缺專案下的協同成果，這賦予了 TR-68 超越一般行業建議書的地位：
blocks.en: TR-68 was developed jointly by PDA and ISPE under the EMA's inter-association drug shortage project, which gives TR-68 a status beyond an ordinary industry recommendation:

blocks.zh: 產品層面（product level）：TR-68 的風險評估框架
blocks.en: Product level: the TR-68 risk assessment framework

blocks.zh: 系統層面（systems level）：ISPE 的供應鏈整體設計
blocks.en: Systems level: ISPE's overall supply chain design

blocks.zh: TR-68 強調的「risk-based framework at a product level」，與 ICH Q9(R1)、ICH Q10 的品質系統框架相互呼應——製造合規不是終點，而是預防短缺的必要基礎。
blocks.en: The "risk-based framework at a product level" emphasized by TR-68 echoes the quality system frameworks of ICH Q9(R1) and ICH Q10: manufacturing compliance is not the end point but a necessary foundation for preventing shortages.

blocks.zh: 「industry and regulators are still on a learning curve」這句話是對整個行業的誠實評估——接受監管機構的稽查意見和 CAPA（corrective and preventive action，矯正與預防措施）作為學習機會，而非視之為威脅。
blocks.en: The statement "industry and regulators are still on a learning curve" is an honest assessment of the whole industry: accept regulatory inspection observations and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) as learning opportunities rather than treating them as threats.

blocks.zh: Q1：「lack of redundancy（缺乏冗餘）」是短缺原因之一。對一個 CDMO 而言，哪些層面可以建立冗餘設計？（提示：設備、供應商、場址、分析方法）
blocks.en: Q1: "Lack of redundancy" is one of the causes of shortage. For a CDMO, at which levels can redundancy be built in? (Hint: equipment, suppliers, sites, analytical methods)

blocks.zh: Q2：為何「near miss（幾乎發生的短缺）」在 TR-68 的框架中與實際短缺同等重要？此概念與 ICH Q9(R1) 的風險評估如何對應？
blocks.en: Q2: Why is a "near miss" (a shortage that almost happened) as important as an actual shortage in the TR-68 framework? How does this concept map to risk assessment under ICH Q9(R1)?

blocks.zh: Q3：TR-68 指出業界與監管機構在風險導向方法的應用上「仍在學習曲線上」。以你的工作經驗為例，哪個 QRM 工具（如 FMEA、FTA、HACCP）最難在實際短缺預防中一致且動態地應用？
blocks.en: Q3: TR-68 notes that industry and regulators are "still on a learning curve" in applying risk-based approaches. Drawing on your own work experience, which QRM tool (such as FMEA, FTA, HACCP) is the hardest to apply consistently and dynamically in actual shortage prevention?

blocks.zh: 管理責任  |  p11–p12
blocks.en: Management Responsibilities  |  p11–p12

blocks.zh: 核心概念：資深管理階層的三層問責義務
blocks.en: Core concept: the three layers of accountability of senior management

blocks.zh: Section 4.0 確立了 MAH 資深管理階層（Senior Management）的問責結構，涵蓋三個層次：
blocks.en: Section 4.0 establishes the accountability structure of MAH senior management, covering three layers:

blocks.zh: 第一層：對產品可及性負責 — 確保藥品以所需數量、正確品質持續供應
blocks.en: Layer 1: responsible for product accessibility: ensure the drug is supplied continuously in the required quantity and with the correct quality

blocks.zh: 第二層：對合規維持負責 — GMP、GDP、法規承諾，含第三方廠商的監督
blocks.en: Layer 2: responsible for maintaining compliance: GMP, GDP and regulatory commitments, including oversight of third-party providers

blocks.zh: 第三層：對短缺預防與應對負責 — 主動與監管機構對話，制訂行動計畫
blocks.en: Layer 3: responsible for shortage prevention and response: engage proactively in dialogue with regulators and develop action plans

blocks.zh: 特別重要的是：MAH 對 CDMO 的品質與供應風險負有不可委派的問責義務（non-delegable accountability）——即便製造已委外，MAH 依然是監管機構的主要責任方。
blocks.en: Especially important: the MAH has non-delegable accountability for the quality and supply risks of the CDMO; even when manufacturing is outsourced, the MAH remains the party primarily responsible to the regulators.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：MAH 委託 CDMO 就像「建案甲方委託建設公司」
blocks.en: Analogy: an MAH commissioning a CDMO is like "a property developer commissioning a construction company"

blocks.zh: 想像一個建案：建案甲方（MAH）委託建設公司（CDMO）蓋房子。甲方不親自施工，但：
blocks.en: Imagine a building project: the developer (MAH) commissions a construction company (CDMO) to build a house. The developer does not do the construction personally, but:

blocks.zh: 甲方仍需向買家（病患/社會）保證房屋品質
blocks.en: The developer still has to assure the buyers (patients/society) of the quality of the house

blocks.zh: 若建設公司偷工減料，甲方向買家負責（不能以「我不知道」為由免責）
blocks.en: If the construction company cuts corners, the developer is answerable to the buyers ("I didn't know" is not a defense)

blocks.zh: 合約中必須載明建材規格（質量標準）、交屋時程（供應計畫）和工程檢查機制（稽核計畫）
blocks.en: The contract must specify material specifications (quality standards), handover schedule (supply plan) and project inspection mechanisms (audit plan)

blocks.zh: TR-68 這段話的法律意涵非常明確：「Contracts and third-party relationships should be established with clear expectations and obligations」——模糊合約是供應鏈風險的溫床。
blocks.en: The legal implication of this statement in TR-68 is very clear: "Contracts and third-party relationships should be established with clear expectations and obligations"; vague contracts are a breeding ground for supply chain risk.

blocks.zh: 風險分流模型（Risk Triage Model）的預告
blocks.en: Preview of the Risk Triage Model

blocks.zh:
TR-68 的結構化方法預告：

  MAH 可指派一名「供應鏈風險監測員」
  (類似內稽員 / 風險管理員的角色)

  其職責：
  ┌─ 持續監控可能導致短缺的信號
  ├─ 提供管理層及時的風險資訊
  └─ 觸發行動計畫與資源配置決策

  詳見 TR-68 後續章節（Section 3.3 及附錄）
  的「Risk Triage Model」工具
blocks.en:
Preview of the TR-68 structured approach:

  The MAH may designate a "supply chain risk monitor"
  (a role similar to an internal auditor / risk manager)

  Responsibilities:
  ┌─ continuously monitor signals that may lead to shortages
  ├─ give management timely risk information
  └─ trigger action plans and resource allocation decisions

  See the "Risk Triage Model" tool in the later sections
  of TR-68 (Section 3.3 and the appendices)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：將 Section 4.0 轉化為合約條款
blocks.en: CDMO application: turning Section 4.0 into contract clauses

blocks.zh: 基於 TR-68 Section 4.0 的要求，CDMO 與 MAH 的品質協議（Quality Agreement）應明確涵蓋：
blocks.en: Based on the requirements of TR-68 Section 4.0, the Quality Agreement between the CDMO and the MAH should explicitly cover:

blocks.zh: 產能承諾條款：界定「capacity constraint（產能限制）」的通知門檻與時限
blocks.en: Capacity commitment clause: defines the notification threshold and timeline for a "capacity constraint"

blocks.zh: 品質事件升報程序：OOS、偏差、設備故障對供應的影響評估時限
blocks.en: Quality event escalation procedure: timelines for assessing the supply impact of OOS results, deviations and equipment failures

blocks.zh: 稽核權利條款：MAH 對 CDMO 的品質監督不可被合約排除
blocks.en: Audit rights clause: the MAH's quality oversight of the CDMO cannot be excluded by contract

blocks.zh: 應急供應計畫：雙方共同維護的 Drug Shortage Prevention Plan（DSPP）
blocks.en: Contingency supply plan: a Drug Shortage Prevention Plan (DSPP) jointly maintained by both parties

blocks.zh: 監管機構溝通：預期短缺時由 MAH 主導對話，CDMO 提供技術支援的分工
blocks.en: Regulator communication: division of roles in which the MAH leads dialogue and the CDMO provides technical support when a shortage is anticipated

blocks.zh: Q1：TR-68 指出 MAH 資深管理對 CDMO 的品質與供應風險負有問責。若 CDMO 發生設備故障導致批次廢棄，MAH 在法規層面的責任如何分擔？（分別就 FDA 和 EMA 的立場討論）
blocks.en: Q1: TR-68 states that MAH senior management is accountable for the quality and supply risks of the CDMO. If equipment failure at the CDMO leads to a rejected batch, how is the MAH's regulatory responsibility shared? (Discuss from the FDA and EMA perspectives separately.)

blocks.zh: Q2：「Proactive QRM（主動品質風險管理）」被列為品質文化要素之一。你認為在 CDMO 環境中，哪個 ICH Q9 工具最適合用於供應短缺的「早期預警」信號偵測？
blocks.en: Q2: "Proactive QRM" is listed as one element of quality culture. In a CDMO environment, which ICH Q9 tool do you think is best suited to detecting "early warning" signals of supply shortage?

blocks.zh: Q3：TR-68 提到可設置「類似內稽員的短缺監測員角色」。此角色在現實中如何與 QA、Supply Chain、Regulatory Affairs 三個部門協作，而不造成職責重疊或資訊孤島？
blocks.en: Q3: TR-68 mentions setting up a "shortage monitor role similar to an internal auditor". In practice, how would this role work with QA, Supply Chain and Regulatory Affairs without overlapping responsibilities or creating information silos?

blocks.zh: 重點提示：品質文化七大要素與短缺預防
blocks.en: Key point: the seven elements of quality culture and shortage prevention

blocks.zh: TR-68 列出的品質文化（quality culture）七大要素，每一項都與藥品短缺的預防直接相關：
blocks.en: TR-68 lists seven elements of quality culture, each of which is directly relevant to preventing drug shortages:

blocks.zh: 本節總結 — Section Summary (Sections 3.0–4.0)
blocks.en: Section Summary (Sections 3.0-4.0)

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺是全球性多因素問題：Figure 3.0-1 的四大類因素（製造、商業、經濟/地理、可靠性）提醒我們，短缺並非只是製造失敗，而是整個生態系統交互作用的結果。2008–2009 年乙腈大短缺是最具代表性的教學案例，示範了地理集中風險與跨轄區衝擊的真實樣貌。
blocks.en: Drug shortage is a global, multifactorial problem: the four categories of factors in Figure 3.0-1 (manufacturing, business, economic/geographic, reliability) remind us that a shortage is not just a manufacturing failure but the result of interactions across the whole ecosystem. The 2008-2009 acetonitrile shortage is the most representative teaching case, showing what geographic concentration risk and cross-jurisdiction impact look like in reality.

blocks.zh: 定義差異影響合規義務：FDA、EMA、WHO 對「藥品短缺」的定義各異，EU 各成員國更有本地定義。CDMO 必須掌握所有服務市場的定義邊界，以確定通報義務的觸發條件。
blocks.en: Definition differences affect compliance obligations: FDA, EMA and WHO define "drug shortage" differently, and EU Member States have local definitions as well. A CDMO must master the definition boundaries in all served markets to determine the trigger conditions for notification obligations.

blocks.zh: 通報是法律義務，非選擇性行為：美國 Section 506C、EU GMP Directive Article 13、EudraLex Vol.4 Ch.5 Sec.5.71 等均確立了法定通報義務。EMA 2019 年指引已明確推薦 MAH 採用 TR-68 作為參考框架，賦予本報告準法規文件地位。
blocks.en: Notification is a legal obligation, not optional: US Section 506C, EU GMP Directive Article 13 and EudraLex Vol. 4 Chapter 5 Section 5.71 all establish statutory notification obligations. The 2019 EMA guidance explicitly recommends that MAHs adopt TR-68 as a reference framework, giving this report quasi-regulatory status.

blocks.zh: 製造與品質問題是 TR-68 的核心聚焦：供應鏈的短缺起點遠比藥房缺貨更早——從 API 起始原料無法取得就已開始。過度依賴單一供應商、缺乏冗餘設計、以及各國進口測試要求，都是將「near miss」演變為實際短缺的風險放大器。
blocks.en: Manufacturing and quality problems are the core focus of TR-68: the starting point of a shortage in the supply chain is much earlier than an empty pharmacy shelf; it begins as soon as API starting materials cannot be obtained. Overreliance on a single supplier, lack of redundancy and country-specific import testing requirements are all risk amplifiers that turn a "near miss" into an actual shortage.

blocks.zh: 資深管理階層的問責不可委派：即便製造已委外給 CDMO，MAH 資深管理對品質合規、供應連續性及與監管機構的主動對話，依然負有不可轉移的問責義務。品質文化的七大要素（含主動 QRM 和暢所欲言環境）是預防短缺的組織基礎，而非可選的管理加分項目。
blocks.en: Senior management accountability cannot be delegated: even when manufacturing is outsourced to a CDMO, MAH senior management retains non-transferable accountability for quality compliance, continuity of supply and proactive dialogue with regulators. The seven elements of quality culture (including proactive QRM and a speak-up environment) are the organizational foundation for preventing shortages, not an optional management extra.
